We are about one block inside from HWY 64 so that you can enjoy scenery in the daytime and start gazing at night. You will also enjoy watching wildlife and San Francisco peaks. blurb: The Canyon Motel & RV Park is located on 13 acres in the City of Williams, Arizona on the famous Route 66. We have unique lodging choices - historic Route 66 motel, authentic Caboose and Railcar suites, RV Park and tent camping, and an onsite Nomad RV home. We also have the Hidden Garden Patio for small gatherings.
